episodes.name: Here Be Monsters
episodes.overviewEn: Madame X, attempting to poison Gotham's water supply, doses Batman with a strange toxin causing him to hallucinate and see everyone around him as monstrous villains.

episodes.name: Broken Nose
episodes.overviewEn: Alfred treats Batman for the first broken nose of his illustrious career, right before the Caped Crusader has to go out and confront the metallic-armored Mabuse in a furious fist fight.

episodes.name: Two of a Kind
episodes.overviewEn: Two-Face has his face reconstructed and is seemingly rehabilitated, but is tempted back to the dark side by a femme fatale.

episodes.name: Case Study
episodes.overviewEn: The Arkham Asylum staff discusses the origins and dubious sanity of The Joker.

episodes.name: Black and White Bandit
episodes.overviewEn: A painter who has lost his sense of color due to toxic paint fumes exacts his revenge in a series of black-and-white themed crimes, where everything he steals has a black-and-white motif.

episodes.name: Punchline
episodes.overviewEn: Told silently, Harley Quinn attempts to trick another criminal out of their ill-gotten gains by inspiring the fear of Batman in them. Her attempts to mimic the Caped Crusader, however, cannot match up to the man himself.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overviewEn: At the scene of a train wreck which may well be the result of malice rather than an accident, Batman seizes on the smallest of clues to follow someone's trail through the train system and up into the light. Here he finds a small boy and reassures him that he is now safe, telling him that he knows what it's like to be young and lost.

episodes.name: Perpetual Mourning
episodes.overviewEn: In this Eisner Award nominated story, Batman conducts an autopsy on a murder victim to help find her killer.

episodes.name: A Game of Bat and Rat
Sunrise
episodes.overviewEn: An elderly woman encounters an injured Batman and muses on the importance of memories.
